title: Case Notes — True-Up Reserve on a Utility Pass-Through Service Final-Statement Prepayment
content:
**Rule.** When a prepayment of the estimated final Utility Pass-Through Service statement is quoted, a true-up reserve is added where the latest water read is an estimated read: 30 percent of the latest water usage charge where the account has two or more estimated water reads taken in the last two months, 15 percent of it where that estimated read is the only one taken in the last two months, and nothing where the latest water read is not an estimated read; the reserve is rounded half up to the cent. The reserve is added to the prepayment quoted.

**Terms.** The latest water read is the water read with the latest read date on the account. An estimated water read is taken in the last two months when fewer than 2 whole months separate its read date from the handling date. The latest water usage charge is the water usage charge with the latest statement date.

## Cases (hypothetical; latest water usage charge 33.62)

| Case | Latest water read | Estimated water reads in the last 2 months | Reserve |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Estimated | 2 | 30 percent of 33.62 is 10.086, so 10.09 |
| 2 | Estimated | 1 (the latest read itself) | 15 percent of 33.62 is 5.043, so 5.04 |
| 3 | Actual | 1 earlier estimate | nothing — the latest read is not an estimate |
| 4 | Final or verification re-read | 0 | nothing |

**Note on case 3.** An earlier estimated read does not bring in a reserve when the latest water read is an actual read.
